notes.title: Assassination Mode
notes.notes:
[p][b]Cut off the head, and the body falls.
[/b]In this deadly twist on the battlefield, brute force alone won’t be enough. Somewhere on the map, behind fortified lines and enemy squads, stands a single target: the enemy commander. Eliminate them, and the war is yours.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/23c319a53ef260cf7a1e62787bb7526d5e6c88ac.png"][/img][/p][p]But be warned — they know you’re coming.
Their defenses are tighter. Their patrols, sharper. Their warriors fight with renewed fury to protect their leader. You’ll have to think like a hunter, strike with precision, and reshape your entire strategy around a single, decisive kill.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/a60c7d856ed8551a579485683e044cae1f7852c5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Key Features of Assassination Mode:[/b][/p][p]🗡️ [b]Target-based gameplay[/b] – Victory is achieved by eliminating the enemy commander
🎯 [b]Dynamic enemy behavior[/b] – The commander adapts and relocates, protected by elite units
⚔️ [b]Stealth, distraction, and deception[/b] become just as important as brute strength
🏹 [b]High-risk, high-reward[/b] missions that demand surgical precision[/p][p]Push past their lines. Outsmart their scouts. Break their ranks. And when the moment comes, make it count.[/p][p]One blade.
One chance.
One kill.[/p][p]And remember — this is just another chapter in the ever-expanding saga of [i]Tribe Nation[/i].

notes.title: Battle Goals: Survival
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hail, Warriors![/b][/p][p]The drums of war thunder once more — and this time, it’s not about conquest or escape. It’s about [b]endurance[/b]. We’re proud to unveil the third Battle Goal in [i]Tribe Nation[/i]: [b]Survival[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/dfca6a03ab7adef090205522e21b40dcd71a6178.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Survival mode – Stand your ground
[/b]In this unforgiving challenge, your tribe is pushed to the brink. Wave after wave of relentless enemies will descend upon your position, and only those with sharp instincts, solid tactics, and unbreakable will can hope to survive.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s no retreat. No safe path. Just you, your warriors, and the ever-growing swarm.[/p][p]Unit options and strategic boosts will be at your disposal to help you stand against the tide. Prove your worth in the crucible of endless assault and let your enemies break upon your defenses like waves on stone.[/p][p]And remember — this is just one more step in the growing saga of Battle Goals. notes.title: Battle Goals: Harvest
notes.notes:
[b]Chieftains![/b]
As the fires of resistance continue to burn bright, we return with the next thrilling addition to Tribe Nation’s evolving battlefield experience — the second of our Battle Goals: Harvest.

The Harvest mode – Gather to survive

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/eba8320c84a963cf725f96877759d29756325c22.png[/img]

In Harvest, the battlefield turns into a deadly scramble for resources. Scattered across the map, vital supplies await — but claiming them is only half the challenge. You’ll need to gather, defend, and transport these resources safely back to your base, all while enemies close in.
This isn’t a fight for glory — it’s a fight for survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/7af0eefd6349e645255cd836b5f5f1c9c0a2e0dc.png[/img]

Move too slow, and you’ll be overrun. Split your forces poorly, and you risk losing everything. Success in Harvest demands speed, precision, and the ability to adapt on the fly.

[b]Key Features of Harvest Mode:[/b]
🌾 Dynamic resource spawning on the battle map
🏃 Strategic gathering and extraction mechanics
⚔️ Intense pressure from roaming enemy units
📦 A brand new gameplay rhythm: scout, grab, survive, repeat

This is just the next chapter in the Battle Goals saga. More modes and secrets are still to come, as the struggle for your tribe’s future grows fiercer with each update.
The land offers no mercy — only the chance to fight for one more day.

Sharpen your blades. Rally your tribes. Defend your legacy.

notes.title: Battle Goals: Caravan
notes.notes:
[b]Hail, Warriors![/b]
In today’s update, we’re excited to share some fresh details about what’s coming next to Tribe Nation — our roguelite strategy game where you lead a proud Celtic tribe fighting for survival against the ever-advancing Roman Empire.

You’ve already heard whispers of new game modes on the horizon — the Battle Goals! Now it’s time to lift the veil and give you a glimpse into what these battle-driven objectives are all about. In the latest Dev Diary, our very own Jindřich Skledal introduces [b]the first of the Battle Goals: Caravan.[/b]

[previewyoutube=8lIqWMT1-BQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Caravan mode – Protect what matters most[/b]
Caravan brings a whole new layer of strategic depth to the game. In this mode, your warriors must focus on [b]safely escorting a caravan loaded with precious resources[/b] to a designated point on the map. Sounds simple? Think again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/bf1419b41ec550a84590165fc9f25638af71c04a.png[/img]

You'll need to rethink your usual tactics, every decision will matter. Enemies behave differently here, striking with precision and aggression to destroy what your tribe holds most dear. The stakes have never been higher. To spice things up even further, the [b]battle map will be reworked[/b] to challenge your adaptability and force you to find new paths to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/cf161a0d242edcbcde48a856d759eefa402d83eb.png[/img]

[b]Key Features of Caravan Mode:[/b]
⚔️Tactical escort missions with high-risk, high-reward mechanics
⚔️New enemy AI with new attack patterns
⚔️Brand new map layout designed specifically for this mode
⚔️Fresh gameplay loop built around movement, defense, and resource protection

Stay tuned, warriors — this is only the beginning. 
More Battle Goals and exciting updates will be revealed soon!

notes.title: Your Tribe, Your Voice – We’re Listening!
notes.notes:
[b]Tribal leaders[/b], your voices have been heard! We’ve gathered an incredible amount of feedback about our real-time strategy from the community, and we couldn’t be more grateful for your insights. Every battle you fight, every strategy you refine, and every challenge you overcome helps shape the future of Tribe Nation – the game in which you lead a Celtic tribe across Europe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/f2bfe6bc0b79c5a529178eb096bb9eb3d0d286d7.jpg[/img]

Right now, we are carefully analyzing all the feedback we’ve received. Our goal is to identify the most impactful changes and improvements that align with our vision for the game while staying true to what makes [b]Tribe Nation[/b] a thrilling and immersive experience. Your suggestions on combat balancing, resource management, unit progression, UI, and dynamic events are invaluable, and we’re taking the time to ensure that our next steps make a real difference.

Very soon, we’ll be sharing a detailed plan for future updates, to show you how we plan to enhance Tribe Nation based on your input. While we can’t promise that every idea will make it into the game, we are committed to implementing meaningful improvements that elevate gameplay and bring even more depth to your journey through the Gallic Wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/fbeac3dbab49734a98bc9114a7cf72f89bc2cee5.jpg[/img]

[b]About Tribe Nation[/b]
Tribe Nation plunges you into the heart of the Gallic Wars, where you lead a Celtic tribe on their journey across Europe as they try to find a safe home before the Roman legions run up to them. This roguelite real-time strategy game challenges you to master dynamic hex-based combat, manage scarce resources, and navigate a treacherous landscape of political intrigue. Will your tribe rise to become a nation, or will it be crushed beneath the Roman heel?

[b]Key Features:[/b]
⚔️ Dynamic Campaign: Experience procedurally generated levels, ensuring unique challenges in each playthrough.
⚔️ Strategic Battles: Engage in real-time combat on hex-based maps, where formation and positioning are crucial.
⚔️ Resource Management: Gather resources, craft weapons, and upgrade your units to withstand relentless Roman pursuits.
⚔️ Event-Driven Narrative: Encounter diverse story events that influence your tribe’s journey, offering diverse rewards and challenges.
⚔️ Cultural Depth: Unlock druidic, martial, and tribal knowledge to enhance your tribe’s capabilities and morale.

Forge your path through ancient Europe, adapt to ever-changing circumstances, and transform your tribe into a resilient nation capable of defying the might of Rome.

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/f2860dee30d992c363e61402cde00ae0f4b67580.png[/img]

[h3]Battle Goals[/h3]
Battles will have more objectives than just conquering the opponent's camp. The new set will include well-known RTS mechanics such as Assassination, Hostage Situations, Survival, and more, depending on what works best. We are addressing some reviews that mentioned battle repetitiveness.

[h3]Roguelite elements[/h3]
The game will feature optional roguelite elements. We plan to implement legacy points that you can collect during runs and spend to acquire permanent wisdoms. Additionally, we plan to give chieftains special abilities, such as the ability to retain reinforcements from battles.

[h3]?[/h3]
Please let us know what you would like to see on the roadmap. We are considering a one-screen mode, multiplayer PvP duels, new game modes, and more.

notes.title: Print your own skull!
notes.notes:
Now you can download and print a model of the tribal chief's skull, which appears in the game under the main menu on your home 3D printer. In the main menu, you will find the skull of the chief who led his tribe to a new home. When he died, his people engraved the story of their journey, the story of the game, onto his skull. From being driven out by the legions of Julius Caesar from their original homeland, through battles with enemy Celtic tribes, to the final confrontation with Julius Caesar and their departure to Ireland, their new home.

notes.title: Developer Diary #1
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave chieftains!

Time for a quick dive into the making of [b]Tribe Nation[/b]. We spilled the beans on our [b] RTS and roguelite[/b] combo set [b]during the Gallic Wars[/b] not too long ago, and the response has been pretty great. Thank you!

[h2]Development Hustle: Six Months Down, More to Go[/h2]
So, we've been at this for about half a year now. Still got some roguelite tricks up our sleeves, but let's talk about what's been cooking in the RTS pot, especially the battle hex map. 

Check out this quick GIF of[b] how the appearance of the randomly generated maps has changed[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/87a42f8273833ff25b3e63ebed126c6d34ac036a.gif[/img]

[h2]Battle Shenanigans: Building Stuff, Riding Things[/h2]
The combat side of things is starting to look pretty good. You can build fortifications, erect structures like towers, bridges or defensive walls, roll out vehicles and mobile war machines such as rammer and siege tower or catapults, and yeah, ride a horse or chariot. It's been a wild ride from basic moves to this. 

Peep this GIF showing how[b] units and machines [/b]have been getting their act together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/b6c45747d08348dd0247a7a72180bb11effe449c.gif[/img]

[h2]Units, Gear, and a Bit of Historical Swagger[/h2]
Now, let's talk soldiers. We're all about historical flair here. No cloak, no existence, right? So, our soldiers are rocking historically appropriate gear, including cloaks. You'll spot wire helmets, wooden helmets, linothorax, metal helmets. Swords, bows, pikes, slingshots, and Celtic Cleavers are in the arsenal. We believe in the details, and it's not just about what they wear; it's about how they fight. 

Check out this GIF showing the [b]first fight and how things have evolved after six months[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/b2b24a8a68226e2ddfb74ee3d413aeec8d2d8532.gif[/img]


[h2]Next Up: Crafting the Non-Combat Stuff[/h2]
We're knee-deep in making the non-combat part more interesting and nicer - you know, [b]looting, shops, wisdom, inventory, crafting[/b], and the whole text adventure package. Currently fine-tuning the [b]user interface[/b] to make sure you can smoothly transition between tactical warfare and some roguelike wandering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825974/460f69ba522f1168b649eceacccdfef5358228d1.gif[/img]
